why: The trend_switch timer as the site's 2x preset runs it: SSO (2x S&P 500) while SPY is more than 3% above its 175-day SMA, IEF once it is more than 3% below, evaluated daily at the close with hysteresis. Pins the once-per-date state shared across both basket names, string timer params, the undecided-until-warm state, a 400-day warm-up and California rates over 2007-2026 (2008, 2020 and 2022 included).
